D5/S3/CharacterSums/Fermat/CharacterPoin.name: D5.S3.CharacterSums.Fermat.CharacterPointCount.norm_jacobiSum
D5/S3/CharacterSums/Fermat/CharacterPoin.signature: lemma norm_jacobiSum {χ ψ : MulChar F ℂ} (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) (hχψ : χ * ψ ≠ 1) : ‖jacobiSum χ ψ‖ = Real.sqrt (Fintype.card F)

D5/S3/CharacterSums/Fermat/CharacterPoin.name: D5.S3.CharacterSums.Fermat.CharacterPointCount.power_fiber_card_eq_one_add_character_sum
D5/S3/CharacterSums/Fermat/CharacterPoin.signature: theorem power_fiber_card_eq_one_add_character_sum (χ : MulChar F ℂ) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hχ : orderOf χ = d) (a : F) : (Nat.card {x : F // x ^ d = a} : ℂ) = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Ico 1 d, (χ ^ i) a
